name: Absorbing (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These items seem to shift and hum when magic is nearby, giving the wielder a soothing sensation.

When the bearer of such items successfully saves against a spell or spell-like ability they also heal a number of hit points equal to twice the spell level of the effect.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Toughness
